name: Tree
summary: Things inside things. Every branch is a disclosure, so the browser opens and closes it and the state survives a reload.
summaryZh: 东西里面还有东西。每一层分支都是一个展开控件,所以开关由浏览器负责,展开的状态也能扛过一次刷新。

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The levels are held apart by indentation alone. The base class on its own is this, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: With guides
variants.note: A rule runs down the side of each level, so the depth of a branch can be seen rather than counted.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The label takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The label takes the title size.

states.name: Open
states.note: The branch is open. The browser announces it, and the arrow turns over.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the label, because the label is what the reader is on.

states.name: Highlight current
states.note: The tree is told to mark the branch the reader is on.

states.name: Current node
states.note: The branch the reader is on. It takes the highlight fill when the tree highlights the current branch.

parts.name: Node
parts.note: One branch. It is a <details>, so it is the element that knows whether it is open.

parts.name: Label
parts.note: The summary. It is the element the browser turns into a disclosure button, so it carries the focus and the keyboard.

parts.name: Text
parts.note: The name of the thing the branch holds.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The mark that says the branch holds something. It is drawn from two borders, so it carries no text of its own.

parts.name: Children
parts.note: The level below. It holds the branches inside this one, each of which is a node of its own.

props.name: open
props.description: Opens the branch. It is the native open attribute on the details, so the browser keeps the state.
props.descriptionZh: 展开这一支。它是 details 上的原生 open 属性,所以状态由浏览器记着。

props.name: variant
props.description: How the levels are held apart. The plain run is the base class on its own; the guided run adds um-tree--lines.
props.descriptionZh: 各层之间怎么区分。无辅助线是只写基类;带辅助线再加上 um-tree--lines。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the label text.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the thing the branch holds. A branch with no text needs an accessible name of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 这一支里那个东西的名字。没有文字的分支也得有自己的可访问名称。

props.name: highlight-current
props.description: Whether the branch the reader is on takes the highlight fill. That branch is marked with um-tree__node--current.
props.descriptionZh: 读者所在的那一支是否带上高亮底色。那一支自己用 um-tree__node--current 标记。

slots.name: children
slots.description: The level below: one node per branch inside this one.
slots.descriptionZh: 下面那一层:这一支里的每个分支放一个节点。

slots.name: default
slots.description: What the branch says. It is the name Element Plus gives the same content the label slot fills.
slots.descriptionZh: 这一支写什么。它是 Element Plus 给 label 插槽所填的同一份内容起的名字。

slots.name: empty
slots.description: What the level below says when there is nothing in it. Without it the level below is empty.
slots.descriptionZh: 下面那一层空着时说什么。不给就空着。

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires when a branch opens or closes. It is the browser's own event on the details — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 某一支展开或收起时触发。这是 details 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

a11y.notes: Every branch is a real <details> and every label is a real <summary>, so the browser announces each label as a disclosure button and says whether its branch is open. The keyboard is the browser's own: Tab reaches the labels, Enter or Space opens the branch. The arrow is drawn from borders, so it carries no text — the state is announced by the browser, not by the mark. The tree role is not used on purpose: it promises tree items and arrow-key navigation, and a tree of disclosures does not deliver either.
a11y.notesZh: 每一支都是真正的 <details>,每一个标签都是真正的 <summary>,所以浏览器会把每个标签播报成展开按钮,并说明它那一支是开着还是关着。键盘也是浏览器自己的:Tab 走到标签上,Enter 或空格展开那一支。那个箭头是边框画出来的,所以它自己不带文字 —— 状态是浏览器播报的,不是那个记号播报的。这里刻意不用 tree 这个角色:它承诺的是树节点和方向键导航,而一棵由展开控件组成的树两者都给不了。

examples.descriptionZh: 三层。各层只靠缩进区分,那个箭头说明哪一支里还有东西。

notes: A branch is a disclosure and not a menu: the browser owns the open state, so the branch stays open across a reload and the reader gets the collapsed and expanded announcement for free. The level below is indented rather than drawn over the label, so a long name has the whole width of the level to itself. The arrow is drawn from two borders, so it takes the label's own colour and a branch that is dimmed dims with it.
notesZh: 一支是一个展开控件,不是一个菜单:开关状态归浏览器管,所以这一支在刷新之后还是开着的,读者也能免费得到「已折叠」「被展开」的播报。下面那一层是靠缩进让出来的,不是盖在标签上面的,所以一个很长的名字有整层的宽度可用。那个箭头是用两条边框画出来的,所以它跟着标签自己的颜色走,变暗的分支也会跟着变暗。
